scenes.title: What if recursion could sing?
scenes.text: What if a recursive function... could sing?

scenes.title: One call. A whole tree.
scenes.text: Meet Seedsong. One recursive call grows a whole tree, and the call tree becomes the music.

scenes.title: Call = note · Leaf = bell · Return = resolve
scenes.text: Every call is a note. Every leaf rings a bell. Every return resolves the phrase.

scenes.title: See the recursion, live
scenes.text: Watch it live: the call stack, and the exact line of code that's playing.

scenes.title: Depth-first wanders. Breadth-first blooms.
scenes.text: Depth-first, it wanders. Breadth-first, it blooms.

scenes.title: Five moods. One tap.
scenes.text: Five moods. One tap. Every note stays in key.

scenes.title: Shape the seed. Grow a grammar.
scenes.text: Shape the seed... or grow a fern from a grammar.

scenes.title: Keep it: WAV · MP3 · MIDI
scenes.text: Then keep your song: WAV, MP3, or MIDI.
